title: Weight of partitions
text: use data Thiem (2011) illustrating function wop() calculates weights partitions. weight partition defined level individual models can calculated consistency coverage value model derived pooled data. weight partition consistency value pooled solution calculated applying consistency formula cases belong partition. weight partition calculated absolute terms calculating separately contribution numerator denominator formula. one divides partition-specific absolute contribution numerator contribution denominator, one receives partition-specific consistency coverage score (depending type formula). arguments functions : n_cut: Frequency threshold pooled data incl_cut: Inclusion threshold (.k.. consistency threshold) pooled data solution: Either C conservative solution (.k.. complex solution) P parsimonious solution amb_selector: Numerical value selecting single model presence model ambiguity. Models numbered according order produced minimize QCA package. one aggregates partition-specific absolute weights -dimension within-dimension, one gets absolute value pooled solution. illustrate following chunk basis absolute weights, one can calculate relative weight partition dividing absolute contribution corresponding value pooled solution.
code: # load data (see data description for details) data("Thiem2011") # calculate weight of partitions wop_pars <- wop(   dataset = Thiem2011,   units = "country", time = "year",   cond = c("fedismfs", "homogtyfs", "powdifffs", "comptvnsfs", "pubsupfs", "ecodpcefs"),   out = "memberfs",   n_cut = 6, incl_cut = 0.8,   solution = "P",   amb_selector = 1) kable(wop_pars) # sum over all cross-sections for consistency denominator sum(wop_pars[wop_pars$type == "between", ]$denom_cons) #> [1] 80.64 # sum over all time series for coverage  numerator sum(wop_pars[wop_pars$type == "within", ]$num_cov) #> [1] 72.39 # relative contribution of cross sections to denominator for consistency wop_between  <- wop_pars[wop_pars$type == "between", ] wop_between$rel_denom_cons <- round(wop_between$denom_cons /    sum(wop_between$denom_cons), digits = 2) kable(wop_between)
